name: Citizenship by Descent / Registration (child of a Cypriot citizen)

qualifying_event.description: A child born abroad (or born out of wedlock) may be registered as a Cypriot citizen where at least one parent was a registered Cypriot national at the time of the child's birth.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Apostilled birth certificate showing both parents' names; parents' Cypriot ID/passport copies; parents' marriage certificate (apostilled if performed abroad), where applicable.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires that at least one parent was a registered Cypriot citizen at the time of the applicant's birth.

evidence_required.document: Apostilled birth certificate showing both parents' names
Parents' Cypriot ID card and passport copies
Parents' marriage certificate, apostilled if performed abroad (where applicable)

sources.title: High Commission of the Republic of Cyprus in the United Kingdom -- Cypriot Citizenship and Registration of Newborns/Minors

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build, and the one route in this country's build with a genuine tier-1 source: an official Cypriot diplomatic mission (High Commission of Cyprus in the UK), consistent with how this dataset has treated other official-government-mission sources for countries whose main government portal blocked automated fetching. Physical presence of the child is explicitly NOT required for the application, per this source. HONEST GAP: no registration age deadline was found in this source (unlike, e.g., Estonia's/Croatia's age-21 deadline for the equivalent one-parent-abroad case) -- not invented here; the source only points to the Directorate of Civil Registry for comprehensive criteria, which was not independently reached in this pass.
